baseline.method: All original samples decoded; footer-pixel classifier locates boundaries, and last-menu/first-preparing/first-copied frames are visually inspected. PTS is video local; it is not the OS click time. The whole-video maximum can include idle capture gaps.
baseline.surrounding_range_note: Includes video samples before the first Preparing frame; the combined surrounding maximum includes an idle capture gap, not an aligned command interval.
